verdict.rationale: INPI runs an online filing portal with user accounts and IP databases, so exporting one's own data in open formats is a fair question for this kind of service. Nothing in the pack documents a user data-export feature, its formats, or account portability. The only data-access item is a probe showing the open-data portal returns HTTP 403 without an account token; that concerns public IP data access, not exporting a user's own data.
